title: Patch: Terminus cards end the world: a set piece and a picture of its own for each Terminus card, Olivian Expanse and Ceaseless Void, and Dice of Doom's d100 rolled on screen
thread:
**Issue #3338 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3338: Patch: Terminus cards end the world: a set piece and a picture of its own for each Terminus card, Olivian Expanse and Ceaseless Void, and Dice of Doom's d100 rolled on screen
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. The owner asked that Terminus cards have crazy animations. They are the game's end-of-the-world cards and should feel it.

### Today

- **The cards.** Terminus cards are the six tokens Olivian Expanse (`stinkyscape-004`, Mythic) Discovers, printed Mythic, all cost 4, plus Ceaseless Void (`core-100`, Mythic), which carries the tag. Dice of Doom (`stinkyscape-154`, Mythic) adds every one of them at (0) on a roll of 67.
- **Art.** One shared black hole (`terminus()` in `stinkyscape.ts`) draws every Terminus token and Olivian Expanse. Ceaseless Void is the procedural painter's generic silhouette.
- **Animations now:**

| Card | Now |
|---|---|
| Olivian Expanse | bespoke `terminusRift` |
| Ceaseless Void | set piece `voidFold`, its own takeover look |
| `004-1` Farewell | the shared `vortex` set piece |
| `004-2` KY's Last Exam | `bolt` |
| `004-3` Event Horizon | none |
| `004-4` Last Word | `snap` |
| `004-5` 1v1 Final Destination | `bind` |
| `004-6` The Big Crunch | none (its Calls to Chaos play) |
| Dice of Doom | `send`, with full-art motion only; its roll is not shown, though the engine reports it (`Rolled`, R2652001) |

### What it should be

Each card gets a picture of its own (base and Radiant, in its set's style) and a signature set piece. Every set piece fits one hold within `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`, a tap skips it, and `bigMoments` and reduced motion still it as #3332 rules.

| Card | Picture | Set piece |
|---|---|---|
| Olivian Expanse | an endless violet expanse with the six Terminus cards as distant falling stars | `terminusRift` grows: the rift opens, six stars circle in it (the six possible cards, not which one), and one falls into the caster's hand |
| Ceaseless Void | a void given form: a hole in the shape of a giant, with stars falling into its outline | `voidFold` grows: the screen's edges fold inward, and every other permanent is pulled into its chest in turn as its `exiled` events say, then the void settles with its 10/10 burning in the dark. Its cost tumbling down over the game shows as the hand card's gem draining |
| Farewell | an empty table under a single lamp, every card gone | the lamp swings, and every permanent and both graveyards lift into the light and fade one by one, then silence and a slow exhale |
| KY's Last Exam | an exam hall at the end of time, one desk, one impossible problem chalked across the sky | the problem writes itself across the board. The answer is a bolt into the enemy hero, a crack through the chalk when it is right, and an Echo glyph stamped on the card |
| Event Horizon | a light caught at the edge of a black hole | time bends: the board smears toward the centre, the turn banner shows twice with a stretched clock, and the extra turn opens with the board snapping back |
| Last Word | a hand catching a falling crown | as lethal lands, everything freezes in mid-strike, the damage numbers crack and shatter, and the turn ends. The next turn opens with every Unit lit for Charge and a countdown that burns away at its end |
| 1v1 Final Destination | one lane of light over an abyss, two heroes at its ends | every lane but one chains shut and drops into darkness, both hero health counters spin down to 1, and the discarded Spells burn off both hands' edges |
| The Big Crunch | the universe collapsing to a point | the board's backdrop collapses to a bright point, then each Call to Chaos it casts plays its own row out of that point, and the point holds until the last one ends |
| Dice of Doom | a hundred-sided die on a black velvet void, 67 glowing faintly on one face | the d100 rolls across the board, tumbling and slowing, landing on its `Rolled` result. On 67 the board goes dark, every Terminus card's star lights in turn, and they rain into the hand. On a miss the die crumbles, and an Embiggened one keeps a Lucky glint. The roll is public |

- Dice of Doom's 67 adds cards to the caster's hand. The opponent sees the stars rain, as the cards' count is public, but never their faces beyond what the view shows (R202).
- The six tokens' Radiant faces gild inside the Radiant rules (R2725004).
- Each card has a sting of its own, built on the Terminus intro family's organ and choir (R1883000).

This part owns these nine cards' pictures and signatures. The per-set picture and signature passes leave them out.

## Acceptance

- Every card above draws its own picture, base and Radiant. They differ from each other and from the shared black hole, and they clear their rarity's floor once #3331 has landed.
- Every card above has a signature entry in its set's table per #3332 (bespoke recipes until it lands). A component spec plays each at desktop size and at 390x844, including Dice of Doom's roll on 67, a miss and Embiggened.
- `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx` covers Ceaseless Void and Dice of Doom's 67 within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`.
- Every set piece stays within `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`. Reduced motion and each `bigMoments` setting show their still or short form, with a test for each.
- No animation shows a hidden card (R202). A test covers Olivian Expanse's Discover and Dice of Doom's 67 from the opponent's seat.
- The rulings are in this issue's block, with the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`, and there is a `--visual` fragment.
- The web tests, `typecheck`, `eslint`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` pass.
```
